name: Send Notification
description: Sends a push notification via Pushover or Prowl. Built from each service's public API docs but not verified against a live account - test with your own credentials first.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Pushover: app token. Prowl: API key.

parameters.name: user_key
parameters.description: Pushover only: your user key. Leave blank for Prowl.
